# Low-risk allowlist. A PR is low risk only when EVERY changed file matches a pattern
# here and none matches .github/risk-tiers.txt (which always wins).
#
# Anything on neither list is high risk. That's deliberate: a new folder, a new cron
# script, or a new plugin module nobody thought to list gets reviewed instead of slipping
# through. Add to this list on purpose, in its own PR, which will itself be high risk.
#
# Read at the PR's BASE commit. fnmatch patterns: `*` also crosses `/`.
